feedback.correct: Assuming that an earlier event caused a later event merely because it came first. Assuming that two events occurring together proves that one causes the other.
hints: Distinguish sequence, correlation, and causation.
Test alternative causes, confounders, and every link in the chain.

slippery_slope_fallacy.message: Look for reverse causation and common causes.
